title: AW7: while a question about money waits, the walk counts the safe side across the kept versions
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 100,000. Pay on the 25th, rent of 330,000 on the 27th. Offline, the phone raised the pay to 260,000 while the desktop kept it at 250,000; the desktop raised the rent to 340,000 while the phone set 330,000. After the sync both are asked (`which`); until the person picks, the newer shows (pay 260,000, rent 330,000) and every version is in `keptVersions`. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 100,000 (bank today) + 250,000 (Pay 25 Jan: the smaller of the kept 250,000 and 260,000 [AW7, AR1]) - 340,000 (Rent 27 Jan: the larger of the kept 330,000 and 340,000) - 0 (minimum) = 10,000
asks.note: The lowest day is 27 Jan; the 25 Feb pay comes after it. With the versions shown and nothing else it would be 30,000, too high while the person has not picked.
